Praise You Jesus, thank You Jesus, and I stand on this stage to thank the Kreupasanam Mother and the Holy Son for the blessings poured upon me and my family.
This is my second testimony, and I stand here for the second time as a witness to this apparition.
I offer millions of thanks to the Holy Son and the Kreupasanam Mother for allowing me this grace, and I want to testify that I was childless for 13 years.
My name is Shalu, I come from Vypin in the Ernakulam district, my husband is Sangeeth Job, and our baby's name is Michaela Maria.
This is our family, and as I mentioned in my first testimony, I had cancer and was childless for 13 years.
The Blessed Mother saved me from the fourth stage of cancer, which I have testified to before.
Because of that illness, there was no chance of us having children.
The disease was confirmed while I was undergoing treatment for the first five years.
After that, various medical procedures took place as part of the treatment.
Later, we visited many hospitals regarding this, but there was no possibility, as both my husband and I had a lot of complications.
After I turned 35, my periods became irregular, and my husband also had many deficiencies.
We didn't even have the mental capacity to hope for a child, but once when we came to take the Covenant, I stood in line to get a token to meet the priest.
The token I received was specifically for childless couples, and when I met the priest, he blessed me.
He gave me two medals, and gave me Anointing oil to apply, which I did accordingly.
Miraculously, without any hope, I conceived normally, but I didn't know about it for three months.
Because my cycle was completely irregular and out of rhythm, I couldn't figure anything out.
It was only when I went to the hospital for another reason three months later that I found out I was already three and a half months pregnant, which was a situation I could not have expected in any way.
As I am a girl who had many physical complications and extreme weaknesses, so I must say this was truly a blessing from the Blessed Mother.
By the seventh month, I developed a slight fever, chills, and bleeding, leading to a situation where the baby had to be delivered prematurely.
One couldn't survive but the other baby had to be put on a ventilator, and on the ninth day, the doctor said there was no chance for the baby to survive.
They said the ventilator support had to be removed because they couldn't provide it anymore, leaving me completely shattered.
At that time, I placed my Covenant locket on top of the ventilator where the baby was lying, and we sprinkled blessed salt and prayed.
Miraculously, by that evening, the baby began to breathe normally without any ventilator support.
However, there were other complications; they said there was an intestinal problem and an abdominal issue.
They also mentioned an issue with the head and a lack of lung development, constantly saying there was a severe problem.
But then the very next moment they would say everything was normal, as the Blessed Mother held the baby by the hand and lifted the child up.
On that ninth day, when they had said he wouldn't survive off the ventilator support, the Blessed Mother came to my house that afternoon.
I was lying down, completely tense and unable to sleep, and at that moment, I saw a vision of the Blessed Mother rising from the ocean, from the mud.
After that, there was a heavy shower of miracles.
The doctors would say one thing, the next day they would say everything is normal, then mention a complication again, only to confirm normalcy the following day.
After one or two months of this, a baby weighing one kilo and 650 grams was handed over to me without any health issues.
Since then, the Blessed Mother has been protecting the baby without any other difficulties, and he is now 11 months old.
I never expected this blessing granted through the Holy Son and the Kreupasanam Mother.
I offer millions of thanks to the Blessed Mother and the Holy Son for this incredible grace bestowed upon us solely through Her intercession.
Furthermore, my husband is in the police force, and the last time I came to renew my Covenant, I wrote down a special intention.
Because I have many physical weaknesses, to be honest, I cannot manage standing near a baby on my own for very long.
In that situation, since my husband is currently stationed near our house, I was worried about his job placement.
It would be incredibly difficult if he got a distant transfer during the upcoming police election transfers, so I prayed for intercession.
I prayed, "Mother, please grant him a transfer to the High Court," and the Blessed Mother blessed me with exactly that.
Just like this, last week, an order came notifying that my husband was posted as the High Court Liaison Officer.
A million, million thanks to the Blessed Mother, and I say a million thanks to Her for every single blessing She continues to bestow upon my family.
Through coming and praying at Kreupasanam, no matter what problem comes my way now, the Blessed Mother is with me, and the great power of God is behind me.
Through the Blessed Mother, I was able to rise up in such strong faith.
And regarding the missionary work I did, it was whatever I could do; whenever I went to the RCC for checkups,
I would take the Kreupasanam paper there and distribute it, or if not there, at the General Hospital, or at homes.
During that month, wherever I could take it, I made sure to distribute the Covenant papers.
Also, if someone carelessly threw away the paper, I would bring it back, keep it safe, and give it to those in need.
That is how I continued my Covenant missionary work, and during the time the baby was about to be born, I went to the church for Holy Mass every day.
In the past, I only used to go on Sundays, and though I can't go every day now, back then when the baby was born, I went every day.
Besides that, I would read the Bible every day, three or four chapters daily, without fail.
I made sure of it, and whenever some sorrow came, earlier I would cry but now there is only one thought in my mind.
I must go to the church and pray, firmly believing that through the Divine Mercy of Jesus, the Kreupasanam Mother will work miracles.
I was able to achieve this faith, and now my husband has a brief testimony to share, so I am handing over the microphone to him.
My name is Sangeeth Job, I come from Ernakulam, and as my wife mentioned, I am a police inspector.
The Word of God says, "My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness," and this is completely meaningful in my life.
Because, as my wife said, we were at the peak of weakness, facing an impossible situation, but Jesus makes the impossible possible.
That is what I understood in my life, because from so many deficiencies, God gave us a child, and there is a backstory to this.
In 2014, my wife and I came and met Father Joseph, though our situation wasn't like this back then, and he prayed for us.
After praying, Father told me, "You don't have to choose adoption; God will give you a child, but it will take time, so you must stand united with me."
From 2014 to today in 2026, I have stayed united with Kreupasanam and stood closely with the priest.
But we went through a fiery furnace of suffering; that is the truth, yet even when life passed through that intense furnace, we tried to stay close to God.
The result of that is this child with us today, as in that impossible situation, God made it possible and blessed us with a wonderful child.
My wife and I were so joyful, and when the baby lies on the bed between us, it's hard to believe, but you must believe it.
He blessed us abundantly by giving us such a child, and for a whole year before she was born, even before we knew she was pregnant,
my wife and I used to go to the church for Holy Mass every day together.
This is truly the fruit of staying close to God; as a law enforcement officer, I have always tried to work honestly in my life.
I try to provide maximum help to those who come to us, which is my only real asset, and I continue to do whatever I can.
A thousand thanks to Jesus and the Blessed Mother;
"If you abide in me, and my words abide in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you."

"Letting my words abide in you" means not just listening to the Word, but living according to it, just as seen in the testimony shared by this daughter and son, Shalu and Sangeeth.

It is a powerful testimony to the apparition, "If you abide in me and my words abide in you, ask whatever you wish."

To even think about a child after that was definitely impossible, which is what we and they keep saying, because she was a stage four cancer patient.
And it was the Blessed Mother and Jesus who granted her healing. To then conceive a child was something we can only believe happened because they stood close to God and prayed unceasingly.
Because the Word of God says, "If my words abide in you, ask whatever you wish."

It is the Blessed Mother who teaches us to stay united with Jesus, and it is through the intercession of the Kreupasanam Mother that we can know and experience Jesus more deeply.
